source_snapshot.criteria: Train to expected width and speed with no Errors
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual dependency but does not prove Gen5/Gen6 feasibility.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for positive high-generation capability, Speed Change 56, Gen5 start, records and recovery.

old_problem: Both the starting Gen5 state and Gen6 target stress the high-margin path. A nominal selector or one Gen6 end state cannot prove full-width Gen5 entry, successful equalization, or error-free repetition.
disposition_reason: The source fixes the exact pair, count and clean outcome. A positive Gen5/Gen6 path certificate, vendor primitive, limits and recovery are well-defined runtime inputs. Review Pending is removed while execution remains fail-closed until the channel supports both states and each cycle proves Gen5 entry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2116, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2117 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00038-V002 / f1843ae55b423ccb was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 56 uniquely covers 500 Gen5-to-Gen6 transitions at required width; lower-generation starting cases do not satisfy it.
Require affirmative full-width Gen5 and Gen6 support for root port, switch, retimer, board/backplane, endpoint/GPU, firmware and the pinned LTSSM/NVQual primitive.
Before each request prove the exact path is stable at Gen5/full width, then capture Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and fresh error/health deltas.
Absent support means execution BLOCKED; authoritative SPEC alone may justify N/A. Do not force, downscope or borrow another row's evidence.
Count only 500 complete chronological records and interlock on wrong start, unsupported/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset, evidence gap or thermal/power anomaly.
Preserve first-fault evidence and use signed recovery without clearing or automatic retry.
No capability probe, LTSSM/NVQual, speed force/change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify five hundred genuine full-width Gen5-to-Gen6 transitions after the complete mapped path is certified for both high-generation states.
required_package: Authoritative full-width Gen5 and Gen6 capability evidence for all path elements and firmware
Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 56 build, command and configuration
Approved per-cycle Gen5 entry and Gen6 equalization/LTSSM/settle/error rules
Dedicated SUT, 500-entry ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT FORCE OR EXECUTE until Project Configuration certifies full-width Gen5/Gen6 support and binds Speed Change 56. After point approval preserve baselines and execute entries 1..500, proving Gen5/full width before each request and recording Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, errors and health before the next entry. Stop on first unsupported state, fault or gap; do not clear, downgrade or retry.
test_case.expected_result: With capability proven, all 500 entries independently show full-width Gen5 start and Gen6 settle within the signed envelope, required devices present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error and approved final health. Without support, execution is BLOCKED.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until positive Gen5/Gen6 capability, tool/path, start method and limits are approved. PASS requires 500 complete accepted records. FAIL on force/mismatch, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing capability/input/artifact is BLOCKED; N/A needs SPEC.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED without component-by-component full-width Gen5/Gen6 proof.
Never force, downgrade or count a cycle lacking proven Gen5 entry.
Use only the approved primitive on an isolated SUT with console and stable power/cooling.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and Gen5/Gen6 capability matrix
Pinned Speed Change 56 tool/configuration and topology/lane/firmware map
Gen5-start plus Gen6 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen6/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-force/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported indication, invalid Gen5 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not force, downgrade or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: All source fields agree on Gen5-to-Gen6; missing capability evidence is a project prerequisite, not competing semantics.

blocked.reason: Review-layer semantics are complete; runtime execution is conditionally BLOCKED pending positive high-generation capability and bindings.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; POSITIVE GEN5/GEN6 CAPABILITY GATE CLOSED; NO CAPABILITY PROBE, LTSSM/NVQUAL, SPEED FORCE/CHANGE, PCIE QUERY, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

pending.unlock_condition: Bind authoritative Gen5/Gen6 support and project inputs, then receive point authorization; absent support, keep execution BLOCKED or use N/A only with SPEC.

external_authorities.application: Allows parameterized review with positive support gates, distinct starting-state coverage, evidence preservation, recovery and no retry.
